verse.verse_1: By oath of those that are sent, one after the other. (The verses of the Holy Qur’an or the angels or the winds).
verse.verse_2: Then by oath of those that push with a strong gust.
verse.verse_3: Then by oath of those that lift and carry.
verse.verse_4: Then by those that clearly differentiate the right and wrong.
verse.verse_5: And then by those that instil Remembrance into the hearts.
verse.verse_6: To complete the argument or to warn.
verse.verse_7: Indeed what you are promised, will surely befall.
verse.verse_8: So when the lights of the stars are put out.
verse.verse_9: And when the sky is split apart.
verse.verse_10: And when the mountains are made into dust and blown away.
verse.verse_11: And when the time of the Noble Messengers arrives.
verse.verse_12: For which day were they appointed?
verse.verse_14: And what do you know, what the Day of Decision is!
verse.verse_15: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the earlier people?
verse.verse_17: We shall then send the latter after them.
verse.verse_18: This is how We deal with the guilty.
verse.verse_19: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from an abject fluid?
verse.verse_21: We then kept it in a safe place.
verse.verse_23: We then calculated; so how excellently do We control!
verse.verse_24: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_25: Did We not make the earth a storehouse?
verse.verse_26: For the living and the dead among you?
verse.verse_27: And We placed high mountains as anchors in it and gave you sweet water to drink.
verse.verse_28: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_29: “Move towards what you used to deny!”
verse.verse_30: “Move towards the shadow of the smoke having three branches.”
verse.verse_31: “Which neither gives shade, nor saves from the flame.”
verse.verse_32: Indeed hell throws up sparks like huge castles.
verse.verse_34: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_35: This is a day in which they will not be able to speak.
verse.verse_36: Nor will they be given permission to present excuses.
verse.verse_37: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_38: This is the Day of Decision; We have gathered you and all the earlier men.
verse.verse_39: If you now have any conspiracy, carry it out on Me.
verse.verse_40: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_41: Indeed the pious are in shade and springs.
verse.verse_42: And among fruits whichever they may desire.
verse.verse_43: “Eat and drink with pleasure, the reward of your deeds.”
verse.verse_44: This is how We reward the virtuous.
verse.verse_45: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_46: “Eat and enjoy for a while – indeed you are guilty.”
verse.verse_47: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_48: And when it is said to them, “Offer the prayer” – they do not!
verse.verse_49: Ruin is for the deniers on that day!
verse.verse_50: So after this, in what matter will they believe?
